# Load data

## Eight linked to plasmid

### One different strain cases
```{r,results='asis'}
plasmid_linked_ESCrE_diff_strain <- prolonged_colonization_df %>% subset(index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes==1 & index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_linked==1 & index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster==0) %>% .$household

lapply(plasmid_linked_ESCrE_diff_strain,FUN=function(x){
  df_index %>% subset(household==x) %>% select(household,genomic_id,Species_ST_cluster,visit,plasmids,bla_genes,ESCrE_genes,ESCrE_plasmidic_genes,  bla_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_plasmid_genes,bla_plasmids,ESCrE_plasmids) %>% arrange(visit)   
}) %>% lapply(.,favorite_kable)
```

# Summary: Four cases where prolonged colonization at species-level found, but not strain-level

## One case was different sequence type but no shared ESCrE gene (i.e., likely acquisition)

```{r,results='asis'}
same_ESCrE_species_not_same_strain_no_ESBL_sharing <- prolonged_colonization_df %>% subset(index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster==0 & index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes==0 &index_at_1_and_or_2_Species==1) %>% .$household

lapply(same_ESCrE_species_not_same_strain_no_ESBL_sharing,FUN=function(x){
  df_index %>% subset(household==x) %>% select(household,genomic_id,Species_ST_cluster,visit,plasmids,bla_genes,ESCrE_genes,ESCrE_plasmidic_genes,  bla_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_plasmid_genes,bla_plasmids,ESCrE_plasmids) %>% arrange(visit)   
}) %>% lapply(.,favorite_kable)
```

# Cases explained by ESCrE persistence but not strain

### Novel strain acquisition:
#### 1. 100H - Different E. coli ST - Linked by blaEC-8, but this was on the chromosome of both genomes...
#### 2. 169H- Different E. coli ST 131 clusters - Linked by CTX-M-15 and blaEC-5*. While blaEC-5 was chromosomal, CTX-M-15 was found on plasmid in 1 isolate, suggestive of HGT and/or co-colonization... 

### Plasmid sharing:
#### 1. 1H - Initial colonized with E. coli ST69 with blaCTX-M-15 and blaEC-8*. While blaEC-8 was found in subsequent chromosome of E. coli ST6321 strain, blaCTX-M-15 was found on a plasmid in every strain collected!!

```{r,results='asis',fig.width=10,fig.height=10}
table(prolonged_colonization_df$index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster,prolonged_colonization_df$index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes,prolonged_colonization_df$index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_linked,dnn = c("Strain","ESCrE gene","Plasmid associated"))

same_ESCrE_not_same_strain_df <-  prolonged_colonization_df %>% subset(index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster==0 & index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes==1) 
same_ESCrE_not_same_strain <- same_ESCrE_not_same_strain_df %>% .$household

lapply(same_ESCrE_not_same_strain,FUN=function(x){
  df_index %>% subset(household==x) %>% select(household,genomic_id,Species_ST_cluster,visit,plasmids,bla_genes,ESCrE_genes,ESCrE_plasmidic_genes,  bla_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_plasmid_genes,bla_plasmids,ESCrE_plasmids) %>% arrange(visit)   
}) %>% lapply(.,favorite_kable)

# Plasmid sharing 
venns <- lapply(same_ESCrE_not_same_strain, function(x) {
    housedf <- df_index %>%
        filter(household == x, !is.na(plasmids), plasmids != "") %>%
        arrange(visit)
    
    # One set per strain (union of plasmid clusters across visits)
    sets <- split(strsplit(housedf$plasmids, ";"), housedf$Species_ST_cluster) %>%
        lapply(function(s) unique(unlist(s)))
    visits <- tapply(housedf$visit, housedf$Species_ST_cluster,
                     function(v) paste0("V", paste(sort(unique(v)), collapse = ",")))
    names(sets) <- paste0(names(sets), " (", visits[names(sets)], ")")
    
    # Plasmids carrying an ESCrE beta-lactamase in this household
    escre <- unique(unlist(strsplit(na.omit(housedf$ESCrE_plasmids), ";")))
    
    # Region geometry + the items in each region
    vd <- process_data(Venn(sets))
    regions <- venn_regionlabel(vd) %>%
        mutate(label = vapply(item, function(i) {
            if (length(i) == 0) return("")
            i <- sort(i)
            paste(ifelse(i %in% escre, paste0(i, "*"), i), collapse = "\n")
        }, character(1)))
    
    ggplot() +
        geom_polygon(data = venn_regionedge(vd),
                     aes(X, Y, group = id, fill = count), show.legend = FALSE) +
        geom_path(data = venn_setedge(vd), aes(X, Y, group = id), linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_text(data = venn_setlabel(vd), aes(X, Y, label = name), size = 3) +
        geom_label(data = filter(regions, label != ""),
                   aes(X, Y, label = label), size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.9,
                   fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, label.size = 0) +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = "steelblue") +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.25)) +
        coord_equal() +
        labs(title = x, caption = "* Plasmid cluster carrying an ESCrE β-lactamase") +
        theme_void()
})
names(venns) <- same_ESCrE_not_same_strain
venns

# Replicon types of the gene containing isolates
lapply(same_ESCrE_not_same_strain, FUN = function(x) {
    df_index %>%
        subset(household == x) %>%
        select(household, genomic_id, Species_ST_cluster, visit, plasmids, bla_plasmids, ESCrE_plasmids) %>%
        tidyr::separate_rows(plasmids, sep = ";") %>%
        subset(!is.na(plasmids) & plasmids != "") %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        mutate(bla   = plasmids %in% strsplit(coalesce(bla_plasmids, ""), ";")[[1]],
               ESCrE = plasmids %in% strsplit(coalesce(ESCrE_plasmids, ""), ";")[[1]]) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        group_by(plasmids) %>%
        mutate(n_strains = n_distinct(Species_ST_cluster)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        left_join(mobtyper, by = c("genomic_id", "plasmids" = "primary_cluster_id")) %>%
        select(household, genomic_id, Species_ST_cluster, visit, plasmids,secondary_cluster_id,mash_nearest_neighbor, n_strains, bla, ESCrE,
               sequencing, size, num_contigs, rep_types, relaxase_types, mpf_type, predicted_mobility,
               mash_neighbor_identification) %>%
        arrange(desc(n_strains), plasmids, visit)
}) %>% lapply(., favorite_kable)
```

```{r,results='asis'}
same_ESCrE_plasmid_linked <-  prolonged_colonization_df %>% subset(index_at_1_and_or_2_Species_ST_cluster==0 & index_at_1_and_or_2_ESCrE_genes_plasmid_linked==1) %>% .$household

lapply(same_ESCrE_plasmid_linked,FUN=function(x){
  df_index %>% subset(household==x) %>% select(household,genomic_id,Species_ST_cluster,visit,plasmids,bla_genes,ESCrE_genes,ESCrE_plasmidic_genes,  bla_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_chromosome_genes,ESCrE_plasmid_genes,bla_plasmids,ESCrE_plasmids) %>% arrange(visit)   
}) %>% lapply(.,favorite_kable)
```
